title: Automotive Dealership Digital Twin
tagline: Extend a physical dealership and its vehicles into a browsable, product-focused digital experience.
overview: This automotive demonstration combines a spatially explorable dealership/vehicle environment with detailed vehicle views and 3D presentation. Visitors can move through the space, inspect exteriors and interiors, and access contextual controls or information remotely.

project.name: BMW dealership
project.blurb: The automotive demo shows how a digital twin can connect place and product in one remote experience. Supplied imagery includes a virtual showroom with 3D vehicle models, spatial capture of a BMW SUV, detailed cockpit and dashboard views, and an exterior vehicle view with embedded navigation and information controls. The approved Treedis tour and Vimeo video demonstrate a reusable pattern for remote dealership exploration, orientation, product presentation, and training without asserting a commissioning relationship that is not identified in the supplied materials.

capturedWith: 360-degree spatial capture of dealership/vehicle environments plus detailed 3D vehicle visualization.
